pokedexEntries.ru: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword-edged tail.

pokedexEntries.sa: SEVIPER’s swordlike tail serves two purposes - it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This POKéMON will not give up its long-running blood feud with ZANGOOSE.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

pokedexEntries.em: SEVIPER and ZANGOOSE are eternal rivals. It counters a ZANGOOSE’s dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.

pokedexEntries.dpp: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

pokedexEntries.hgss: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any ZANGOOSE. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

pokedexEntries.bw: For many generations, it has feuded with Zangoose. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.

pokedexEntries.x: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

pokedexEntries.y: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.

pokedexEntries.za: It battles speedy Zangoose using its keenly bladed tail, which oozes an extremely powerful poison.
